name: triangle
description: Classify a triangle given side lengths as a record {a, b, c}. Return a string: "invalid" if any side is less than 1 or the sides violate the strict triangle inequality (each side must be less than the sum of the other two); otherwise "equilateral" (all sides equal), "isosceles" (exactly two sides equal), or "scalene" (all sides different).

spec.input: record{a: int, b: int, c: int}
